summary: Build learning analytics dashboards, governance, and intervention workflows for education institutions. Enroll to turn data into action.
lede: Learning analytics implementation for education institutions helps you turn fragmented LMS, assessment, and institutional data into usable indicators for retention, engagement, progression, and intervention effectiveness. The course shows you how to map data sources, define measurable KPIs, and present findings in a form academic leaders can act on. You will practice designing dashboards, prioritizing interventions, and structuring governance around consent, access, and reporting workflows. You will also explore social network analysis, process mining, predictive models, and natural language processing at an appropriate overview level while building a practical analytics capability within real-world limits of data quality, budget, and existing systems.
audienceIntro: This learning analytics implementation for education institutions training is designed for professionals who manage student, academic, and digital learning data and need to turn it into actionable reporting, interventions, and governance.
audience: Curriculum Development Lead using analytics insights
modules: Predictive and Text Analytics Use Cases
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of education operations, student records, or digital learning environments; basic familiarity with LMS reports, assessment data, or institutional dashboards. You do not need coding skills to complete the course, but you should be comfortable using spreadsheets and reviewing data visualizations. Experience with student support, quality assurance, curriculum planning, or institutional research will help you apply the exercises more quickly. The course introduces predictive and text-analytics concepts at an operational level, not a technical engineering level.
